text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Happy birthday~♪ Your present is some 
strawberry cookies.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
"Wah... Thank you.\nYou remembered that I 
love strawberries."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Wait, Bright. Are those strawberry 
cookies... the ones we had together at the 
tea party?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Yes. It was so flavorful that I wanted 
Suzuka-sama to taste it too~. Could that 
be a present from Dober, perhaps~?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, the exact same one. We matched... 
Sorry about that, Suzuka.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
No, it's fine. I'm really happy. May I 
have it?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Still, it's quite a lot. It won't keep for 
long either, so what should I do...?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
In that case, how about the three of us 
eat together? We can grab something to 
drink at the cafeteria—

text_block_list.name: Dober & Bright
text_block_list.text:
"! In that case, I'll brew my special 
flavored tea for you."

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Fufufu... You two really get along well, 
don't you?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, I might feel the same way even now~. 
Thinking, 'Here's my chance to get closer 
to Suzuka-sama~'♪

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Huh!? Ah, no, umm... L-Let's hurry! To the 
tea party...!
